The '''B-3Z technical droid''' was a model<ref name="Promotion" /> of [[Class two droid/Legends|class two]]<ref name="SWS" /> [[technical droid]]s used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Promotion" /> Between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[insurrection on Culroon III]] as portrayed in "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]" takes place following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that, following the insurrection, [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Zevulon Veers]], and that Zevulon was a teenager in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, Zevulon must have been born by [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]] at the latest, meaning that the insurrection on [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] must have taken place prior to or during that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> two B-3Z technical droids were present in an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport (AT-AT)]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]]. They helped [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] and his crew run diagnostics on the vehicle while the remainder of the [[Army/Legends|army]] on Culroon III attended a ceremony with the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Culroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Veers resorted to activating the AT-AT when the Culroon [[Insurrection on Culroon III|attacked]] the Imperials.<ref name="Promotion" />

==Behind the scenes==
B-3Z technical droids appeared in the short story "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]," published in [[1987]] in [[West End Games]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Promotion" />
